phases.title: Start Here
phases.blurb: What programming actually is, how this course works, the map of what comes next, and getting your computer ready.
phases.goal: Explain what a program is, move around with the terminal, create a JavaScript project with pnpm init, and run your first program with node.

phases.title: Storing Information

phases.title: Making Decisions
